title: Felix Breaks Toward Northeast Trigger
prompt:
Felix breaks out of the Blue Lions formation toward the northeast trigger approach of the Garreg Mach mock battle map. He is a youthful dark-blue-haired duelist in black vest and white sleeves, moving too far ahead with a wooden training sword. Ahead are stone steps, low walls, red-black Black Eagles markers, distant Golden Deer depth, and the faint silhouettes of Hanneman and Manuela near healing sigil ground. Byleth is visible in the background noticing the mistake. Nonlethal academy exercise only.

Cinematic continuity: Block=Mock Battle Expanded. Transition in: Felix sees an opening after the thicket flank motion. Transition out: Byleth steps into Felix path for correction. Screen/camera rule: Felix exits Blue line toward right/deep northeast; Byleth intercepts on the same axis before the trigger zone. Audio bridge: quick footstep, wooden blade, sudden drop in chatter. Generate with 2s editorial handle where possible; begin and end with usable motion, not a frozen poster. Maintain direction, eyelines, and spatial geography from adjacent shots.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. Show tactical pressure through blocking, posture, sound and editing rather than aging faces.

Camera: handheld-like forward drift following Felix toward the northeast opening

Scene09 production gate: do not generate final video from the blocked source image if it is SVG or legacy training-yard raster. Use production_image_path after a real cinematic raster keyframe is generated and QA-approved.
Character continuity gate: every named character must match the listed selected.png reference assets for face, hair, age, costume silhouette, and color accents.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; use controlled academy sparring only, no blood or lethal injury. Avoid: straight training corridor, chalk lane, red-haired Felix, lethal attack, blood, war armor, older faces, generic soldiers, text, watermark
